articles.title: Salt Security Publishes new Salt Labs Research

articles.summary: Salt Labs recently showed that a single email could hijack the AI agent platform Manus and reach a victim’s connected accounts. Learn what the finding means and what it tells every organization now deploying AI agents.
articles.title: When a Security Guardrail Detects the Attack and Still Can’t Stop It

articles.summary: Salt Labs found that the agentic AI platform Manus could be hijacked with a single email. The full attack required nothing from the victim beyond asking Manus to check their inbox. No stolen password, no clicked link.
